posts.zh:
oss-prompt-optimizer 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。将原始指令经 harness llm 服务优化为专业提示词——默认 Role / Task / Context / Format 四段，可配置为无标题纯文本（outputStyle: 'plain'，更省 token）；提供输入框 ✨ 一键优化与撤销、prompt_optimize 工具、自动优化钩子与可配置元提示词。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0244723c0a12f6f44919.html
posts.en:
oss-prompt-optimizer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Optimize a raw instruction into a professional prompt through the harness llm service — four-section (Role / Task / Context / Format) by default, or a headerless plain-text style (outputStyle: 'plain') that cuts token usage. Composer ✨ one-click optimize & undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, configurable meta-prompt.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0244723c0a12f6f44919.html
